title: Stitch Failures by Connection
app: Stitch extraction/load logs via the Stitch Connect API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=stitch:extraction status="failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by connection_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Stitch failures grouped by connection so operators immediately see which specific connections are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Stitch is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Stitch failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical connections.
visualization: Table of connection by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Stitch are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
